plan.hypothesis: Can the complete-sequence path handle all observed length extremes within memory, and what is its short throughput cost?
plan.source: Original eligible rows only, corpus and index hashes verified on CPU.
plan.timing_scope: Pretokenized CPU batches, device transfers, forward/backward and optimizer updates. Tokenization timing is separate; no loader-prefetch speed claim.
plan.gate: Require all runs finite, including long-example stress, within memory. Report observed throughput and peak memory, without selecting a training recipe from a speed-only probe.

covered: Untruncated original token IDs and unchanged logical row order
Exact consumed-row and token resume accounting
Split versus unsplit dropout-free T5 gradients for native, numeric-weighted, example-balanced, smoothed and focal loss
Tiny-model training, checkpoint archival and resume
development_failures: A synthetic question fixture was exactly 128 tokens instead of greater than 128; extended it.
Real-data preflight initially passed a string to the Path-only hash helper; corrected the call.
